parts.gloss: others (here used as an address particle)

literal: To the beloved who loved me, his withholding of love I consented to; my nature that has turned pale, to whom shall I tell, O friend?
translation: I consented to my beloved withholding his love and departing; now, to whom can I complain about this sallow paleness that has overcome my nature?
modern: என்னை விரும்பிய காதலர் எனக்கு அன்பு செய்யாமல் பிரிந்திருப்பதை நான் ஏற்றுக்கொண்டேன்; ஆனால் அதனால் பசலை நிறம் அடைந்துவிட்ட என் உடலின் நிலையை வேறு யாருக்குச் சொல்வேன்?
explanation: The heroine laments her physical state of paleness (pasappu) caused by separation. She admits that she willingly consented (nērntēn) to her lover's departure or his withholding of immediate grace, understanding his situation. However, her body has reacted to the separation by turning pale, changing her natural complexion (paṇpu). She helplessly asks her friend to whom she can complain about this physical suffering, since she herself agreed to the very separation that caused it.
